The transitive reduction of a DAG G is the graph with the fewest edges that represents the same reachability relation as G. It is a subgraph of G , formed by discarding the edges u → v for which G also contains a longer path connecting the same two vertices . Like the transitive closure , the transitive reduction is uniquely defined for DAGs . In contrast , for a directed graph that is not acyclic , there can be more than one minimal subgraph with the same reachability relation .

- 1 small can Hershey's syrup (chocolate)
- 1 Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
- 2/3 c. oil
- 4 eggs
- 1 c. sour cream
- 1 small pkg. pistachio pudding
- miniature chocolate chips

Directions:
- Blend cake mix, oil and eggs together.
- Then add sour cream and pudding mix for 5 minutes.
- Grease pan with Crisco (Bundt pan).
- Sprinkle bottom of pan with chocolate chips.
- Pour little over half of mixture into pan.
- Swirl syrup in with knife.
- Pour rest of mixture on top.
- Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan while still warm.

Beef And Rice "Porcupines"

Ingredients:
- 1 lb. ground beef
- 1/2 c. raw rice
- 1/4 c. chopped onions or to your taste
- 1 tsp. salt
- 1/4 tsp. pepper
- 2 Tbsp. shortening
- 1 can Campbell's tomato soup

Directions:
- Mix beef, onions, salt and pepper. Form into small balls.
- Fry in hot Crisco or Wesson oil.
- Turn frequently until light brown but not crusty on all sides.
- Add tomato soup and water. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes.

Frozen Pumpkin Dessert

Ingredients:
- 1 c. cooked pumpkin

Carrot Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 lb. carrots
- dash of salt
- 1 can tomato soup
- 1/2 c. oil
- 1/2 c. vinegar
- 1 c. sugar
- 1 tsp. mustard
- 1 tsp. pepper
- bell pepper

Directions:

- Drain carrots.
- Layer 1/2 of the carrots in a dish and slice bell peppers and onions on top of carrots.
- Pour mixture over carrots.
- Refrigerate overnight.

Tomato Soup

Ingredients:
- 2 c. tomatoes (about 5)
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 tsp. salt
- 1/4 tsp. black pepper
- dash of cayenne (if desired)
- 2 tsp. sugar
- 2 Tbsp. butter or fat
- 3 Tbsp. flour
- 4 c. milk (scalded)
- celery (optional)

Directions:
- Cook tomatoes, onion, salt and pepper, cayenne and sugar for 15 minutes.
- Melt butter; blend in flour.
- Add milk gradually. Gradually add tomato mixture to milk mixture, stirring constantly. Serve.

Home Made Chicken Noodle Soup

Ingredients:
- chicken pieces
- 1 can mixed vegetables
- 1 can tomato soup
- chicken soup base or cubes
- salt and pepper to taste
- Kluski- dry noodles

Directions:
- Wash, cook chicken in kettle of water.

Grandma Northern'S Zucchini Cake

Ingredients:
- 3 c. grated, unpeeled zucchini
- 4 eggs
- 1 1/2 c. oil
- 3 c. sugar
- 1 c. nuts
- 3 c. sifted flour
- 2 tsp. baking powder
- 1 tsp. baking soda
- 1/2 tsp. salt
- 1 1/2 tsp. cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp. allspice
- 1/4 tsp. ground cloves

Directions:
- Place eggs, oil, zucchini and sugar in a large bowl; blend well.
- Stir in nuts.
- In a separate bowl, mix together the dry ingredients (remaining).
- Combine two mixtures and stir.
- Pour into greased and floured pan.

Better Than Sex Cake

Ingredients:
- 1 stick plus 2 Tbsp. butter
- 1 c. flour
- 1 c. chopped walnuts
- 8 oz. cream cheese
- 1 c. 10x sugar
- 1 1/2 c. Cool Whip
- 1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding
- 1 pkg. chocolate instant pudding
- 3 c. cold milk

Directions:
- Mix butter, flour and walnuts together.
- Grease an 8 x 13-inch glass dish and bake mixture for 12 to 15 minutes.
- Cool.
- Mix cream cheese, 10x sugar and Cool Whip together until smooth and spread over baked crust.
- Cool for 2 hours.
- Mix puddings and milk together.
- Add to cake and refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
- Spread Cool Whip on top

Salmon Casserole

Ingredients:
- 1 (7 oz.) can salmon
- 8 oz. vermicelli
- 1/2 c. diced green pepper
- 1/4 c. pimento
- 1 c. white sauce or 1 can mushroom soup
- 1/4 tsp. salt

Directions:
- Boil vermicelli.
- Mix flaked and drained salmon with sauce and stir thoroughly.
- Mix remaining ingredients.
- Place in medium baking dish in layers with vermicelli.
- Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
- Uncork a bottle of Grey Riesling and savor with the casserole.

Chicken Dijon

Ingredients:
- 2 whole chicken breasts, cut into halves
- 2 Tbsp. butter
- 1 tsp. chicken bouillon (or 1 cube)
- 3/4 c. hot water
- 1/4 c. milk
- 2 to 3 Tbsp. Dijon mustard

Directions:
- Mix bouillon in hot water and set aside.
- Saute chicken breasts in 2 tablespoons melted butter until golden brown.
- Remove chicken from pan and sprinkle flour into drippings and stir.
- Add chicken bouillon to flour and stir until thickened.
- Add milk; stir, then add Dijon mustard.
- When sauce is bubbling, return chicken to pan and cover for 5 minutes.
- Serve with rice.

Pecan Pie Bars

Ingredients:
- 1 pkg. yellow cake mix
- 1/2 c. butter
- 4 eggs, divided
- 1/2 c. brown sugar, packed
- 1 c. light corn syrup
- 1/2 c. dark corn syrup
- 1 tsp. vanilla
- 1 c. chopped pecans

Directions:
- Set aside 2/3 cup cake mix.
- Mix remaining cake mix, butter and 1 egg.
- Mix until crumbly.
- Press in pan; bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
- Mix remaining and beat.
- Pour over crust and add pecans and bake at 350° for another 30 to 35 minutes.
- Cut into bars.

Forgotten Kisses

Ingredients:
- 2/3 c. egg whites (about 4)
- 1/2 c. superfine sugar
- 1/4 c. coarsely chopped walnuts
- 1/4 c. coarsely chopped dates

Directions:
- Cover 2 cookie sheets with heavy brown paper. Brush with oil. In a large bowl, beat the egg whites until soft peaks.
- Gradually beat in the sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, until egg whites are stiff. Gently fold in the walnuts and dates.
- Drop in heaping teaspoonfuls on sheets.
- Bake at 225° for 1 hour. Turn off. Leave overnight.
- Makes 3 or 4 dozen.

Ingredients:

- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 green pepper, chopped

- 1 1/2 tsp. salt

- 1 c. rice

Directions:
- Brown beef in skillet; drain well.
- Add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender.
- Add tomatoes and juice.
- Cut whole tomatoes into chunks.

- Add 1 1/2 cups of water, then the rice.
- Cover and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

- In food processor or blender, combine garlic, ginger, soy sa

Peppernuts

Ingredients:
- 4 c. sugar
- 2 c. butter (do not substitute)
- 2 c. white syrup
- 4 c. cream
- 2 eggs
- 4 Tbsp. baking powder
- 12 c. flour (2 c. more more may be added, if needed)

- 2 tsp. each: cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, pepper, mace, cardamon, allspice and ginger

Directions:
- Cream butter and sugar; add syrup, cream and eggs.
- Mix well. Sift spices with flour and baking powder.

Beef Roast In The Coals

Ingredients:
- 3 1/2 to 4 lb. roast (tip) (about 4 inches thick)
- 1 (6 oz.) jar prepared mustard
- 1 c. salt

Directions:
- Prepare fire so that coals are hot.
- Cover entire surface of meat with mustard.
- Pat salt into mustard until it won't hold any more.
- Insert meat thermometer.
- Place meat directly on coals; rake coals around meat.
- Cook about 45 minutes.
- Turn over and cook 45 minutes (140° rare, 160° medium and 170° well done). Remove meat from coals.
- Remove black crust which formed.
- To serve, across the grain.

- 2/3 c. milk

- 2 Tbsp. chopped pimento
- 2 Tbsp. chopped green bell pepper

Directions:
- Heat soups, milk, onion, pimento and green pepper in saucepan over low heat.
- Stir in cheese until melted.
- Add chicken, macaroni and margarine; mix well.
- Spoon into buttered baking dish.
- Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.
- Yield: 10 servings.

Plain Cake

Ingredients:
- 2 3/4 c. flour
- 1 3/4 c. sugar
- 1 c. Crisco

- 1 tsp. vanilla

- Beat flour, sugar, Crisco, baking powder, salt and milk together for 2 minutes.
- Add eggs, egg yolk and vanilla.
- Bake about 1 hour at 350° in tube pan.

- 1 1/2 lb. sweet or hot Italian sausage or 1/2 and 1/2
- 1 (15 oz.) jar Ragu sauce
- 1 lb. Mozzarella cheese
- 1 (20 oz.) can tomato sauce
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 lb. Ricotta cheese

Directions:
- Brown sausage with garlic.
- Add Ragu sauce and tomato paste. Simmer for 2 to 3 hours.
- Cook 16 ounces ziti according to package instructions.
- In a large casserole dish, place a layer of ziti, then layer of sauce, followed by cheese.
- Repeat process ending with sauce.
- Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°.
- Serve with Parmesan cheese.

Chicken Wiggle

Ingredients:

Directions:

- 100.

- 1 c. oil

- 1 Tbsp. salt

Directions:
- Mix broccoli, slaw, and green onions in large bowl.
- Combine oil, sugar, rice, vinegar, salt and pepper in large jar.
- Shake well, until blended and pour over slaw.
- Mix Ramen noodles, almond, and seeds together with slaw mixture and chill.

Ingredients:
- 2 (8 oz.) cans crescent rolls
- 1 (16 oz.) can refried beans

- 2 Tbsp. taco seasoning mix
- 6 oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
- 1/2 c. chopped green onions
- 1/2 c. sliced olives

- Unroll dough into 4 rectangles.
- Place crosswise in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking dish.

- In a small bowl, combine sour cream and taco mix.
- Bake dough for 14 to 19 minutes.
- Cool completely. Spread beans over crust.
- Spread taco-sour cream mixture over top

Crawfish Pie

Ingredients:
- 1 lb. cleaned crawfish tails
- 1 can cream of mushroom soup
- 1 diced onion
- 1/2 bell pepper
- 3 stalks celery

- 1/4 c. green onion tops
- 1/4 tsp. red pepper

- salt to taste

- 1 can crab meat
- 1 pie crust (top and bottom)

Directions:
- Saute vegetables in butter.
- Add soup, crawfish and crab meat. Add rice.
- Put in pie shell.
- Cover and vent pie crust top. Cook until pie crust is golden brown in 350° to 375° oven.
- Shrimp may be substituted.

Brownie Cupcakes

Ingredients:
- 4 sq. semi-sweet chocolate
- 2 sticks butter
- 1 c. flour
- 1 3/4 c. sugar
- 4 eggs
- 2 tsp. vanilla

Directions:
- Melt chocolate and butter.
- Mix flour and sugar.
- Add eggs, one at a time, stirring as little as possible.
- Add vanilla, chocolate mixture and pecans. Fill baking cups 1/2 full. (Put baking cups in a muffin tin.)
- Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 325°. Makes 20 to 24 cupcakes.
- You can frost, if you desire.

Zucchini Pie

Ingredients:
- 2 C. grated, unpeeled zucchini
- 1/2 tsp. salt
- 3/4 C. Bisquick
- 1/4 C. vegetable oil
- 1/4 tsp. sage
- 2 eggs, beaten
- 1/4 tsp. pepper

- 1/2 C. chopped onion

Directions:
- Mix all ingredients together in large mixing bowl. Pour into greased 9 inch pie plate. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Allow to cool 10 minutes before slicing into pie wedges.

Herb Roasted Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 lb. red skinned potatoes, cut in 1-inch pieces
- 6 Tbsp. olive oil
- 4 Tbsp. chopped, fresh herbs (thyme, rosemary and parsley) or 4 tsp. dried
- 2 cloves garlic, chopped

Directions:
- Preheat oven to 450°.
- Place potatoes on baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
- Using hand, toss to coat evenly.
- Season potatoes with salt and pepper.
- Bake 10 minutes.
- Using spatula, turn potatoes.
- Toss with herbs and garlic and bake until potatoes are golden and tender, about 13 minutes more.
- Makes 4 servings.

- 2 tsp. salt
- 1/2 tsp. sugar
- dash of pepper

Directions:
- Mix rice, beef, egg, onion, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup tomato juice.
- Form into 18 balls and put in skillet.
- Add sugar to remaining juice.
- Pour over meatballs.
- Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 to 25 minutes.

Marvelous Mushroom Gravy

Ingredients:

- 2 c. water
- 1/2 c. chopped onions
- 1 tsp. garlic powder
- 1/4 c. pan drippings or cooking oil
- 1/4 c. flour
- 2 tsp. salt
- 1/2 tsp. black pepper

- Cook coarsely chopped mushrooms in water and salt for 20 minutes.
- Add onions; simmer 3 minutes.
- Sprinkle in garlic powder; add salt and pepper to mix.
- Drain mixture; save stock.

Country Chicken Vegetable Soup

- 3 (14 1/2 oz.) cans Swanson clear chicken broth
- 1/2 c. uncooked long-grain rice

- 2 (5 oz.) cans Swanson chunk white chicken, undrained
- 1 tsp. chopped fresh parsley or 2 tsp. dried parsley flakes

Directions:
- In a 3-quart saucepan, combine broth and rice.
- Over medium heat, bring to a boil.
- Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until rice is tender, stirring occasionally.
- Add mixed vegetables, chicken and parsley.
- Heat through, stirring occasionally.
- Serves 4.

Margaret'S Barbecue

Ingredients:
- 3 or 4 lb. pork or beef
- 1 1/2 c. water
- 1/2 c. tomato catsup

- 1/2 c. Worcestershire sauce
- 1 c. chopped onion
- 3 tsp. brown sugar
- 3 Tbsp. dry mustard
- 1/4 tsp. red pepper
- 1/4 tsp. black pepper
- 1 tsp. salt

Directions:
- Mix all together in a saucepan and cook on top of stove until done.

Bread Pudding

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 c. bread crumbs
- 3/4 c. sugar
- 2 Tbsp. margarine
- 4 c. milk (you can use low-fat)
- 3 eggs
- 2 tsp. vanilla

Directions:
- Heat milk and margarine; pour over bread crumbs and sugar. Stir well until bread becomes very soft.
- Beat eggs; mix well with bread mixture.
- Add vanilla.
- Pour into buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, or until done.
- Refrigerate.
- Very good hot or cold.

Apple Crumble

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 lb. cooking apples
- 1/3 c. water
- 3/4 c. brown sugar
- 2 tsp. grated lemon rind
- 1/2 c. butter or margarine

- 1/2 c. sugar
- 1/4 tsp. ginger
- 1/2 tsp. cinnamon

Directions:
- Peel, core and slice the apples.
- Combine the water, sugar and lemon rind in a saucepan.
- Add the apple slices and cook, covered, until soft.
- Put into a well-buttered pie tin.

Aloha Sweet Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4-5 med. sweet potatoes
- 1/2 c. butter
- 1 c. brown sugar
- 1/2 c. water
- 1/4 c. shredded coconut

Directions:
- Boil sweet potatoes in their jackets until tender, about 25 mins.
- Let cool, then peel and cut into slices 1 1/2 inch thick. In a large skillet melt butter.
- Stir in brown sugar and water and cook on med. heat about 5 min.
- Reduce heat and add sweet potatoes to skillet.
- Cook gently; tossing lightly until sweet potatoes are glazed.
- Sprinkle with coconut before serving.
- Makes 8 servings.

- 1 1/2 c. sugar
- 2 Tbsp. baking powder
- 1/2 Tbsp. salt
- 3/4 c. margarine or butter (1 1/2 sticks)

- 4 large eggs
- 2 c. milk
- 2 tsp. vanilla extract
- 2 c. fresh or frozen blueberries
